next_action.description: Build the MpiFader Primitive. It is NEW work, not MPI-573 - ask Fabio whether to card it before editing, since MPI-573 is 'mic recorder + audio output type' and a fader belongs to the vocals+foley mixing Flow he plans next. Shape: a dB gain control, unity (0 dB) detent that SNAPS within a tolerance (Fabio: 'driving sliders for volume should snap at zero'), sized to sit beside an MpiLevelMeter in a channel strip. Do NOT add snap to MpiProgressBar instead - it is a shared primitive used across the whole app and would need a full consumer sweep, and it still would not own the dB/unity semantics. Do NOT build the MpiMixerStrip Compound yet: it should be shaped by the foley Flow's real requirements, not guessed. Read MpiLevelMeter first - the fader is its counterpart and should match its prop shape (orientation, showValue) so a strip can mount both the same way.

key_decisions: FADER and METER are different dB scales, and conflating them is what prompted the fader. A fader is 0 dB = unity, the neutral middle. A level meter is 0 dBFS = full scale, the ceiling every normal signal sits below. Fabio asked whether green should run to 0 with amber only above it - that is fader thinking; on a meter it would mean no warning until the signal is ALREADY clipped. Meter zones stay green < -12, amber -12..0, rose 0..+12.

WAV was KEPT and the sample rate cut instead. The old 96 kHz was an UPSAMPLE: opus always encodes at 48 kHz, and decoding through a live AudioContext at the hardware rate resampled it up, so 4x the bytes carried no extra information. MP3/m4a were declined - ComfyUI decodes to float32 PCM either way, so the container buys nothing in RAM, only disk and the per-generation Pod upload; and a lossy round trip in front of a voice clone costs quality in the exact workflow the recorder exists for.

The meter feeds on getFloatTimeDomainData. Byte data clamps at +/-1, so a boosted signal reads exactly 0.0 dB and the rose zone can never be reached - the meter would silently lie about the only case it exists to warn about.
meterAnalyser() lives in MpiLevelMeter.js, not in each caller: the recorder and the Settings test must read identically, or the gain you set in one place does not match what the other records.

The Record button lives in the GRID (which owns the toolbar and emits) while the block owns the action - matching the 20 existing grid.on(...) handlers. Not the FLOWS top bar: that is app chrome, so Record would appear outside the gallery with no project to record into.
constraints: MpiGalleryBlock's own header is DEAD MARKUP - MpiGalleryGrid.mount(el) sets el.innerHTML and wipes the block's template, so its crumb/filters/sort slots render nothing while their CSS is live. Pre-existing, left alone, worth its own card.

The dev component gallery is gated on APP_CONFIG.dev_mode (true for any source run), NOT on test_styles - that flag only drives dev page-restore persistence. Do not flip it; it stays false. Reach the gallery through the dev radial menu -> Components.

js/components/types.js and js/shell/preloadStyles.js are also on MPI-599's and MPI-567's file lists. Both peer claims were hours past the index's own 120-minute timeout and both edits here were one appended line; check for drift before touching them again.

getUserMedia is refused in a playwright browser and granted in real Electron. Stub navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with a MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode to drive the whole real path offline - and return a FRESH destination per call, or the second test gets a stream whose track was already stopped. A KNOWN source level (0.25 linear = -12.04 dBFS) is what makes the dB readings assertions rather than impressions.

playwright-cli eval must be ONE line - a multi-line file expanded with $(cat ...) dies with SyntaxError at line 2. Collapse it first (strip // comments, join). Heredocs are blocked by the shell guard; write scripts to the scratchpad and run them by path.

A consumer may only SIZE a Primitive, never restate its chrome. The vertical meter needs height:100% on the component and a sized parent from the consumer - it was collapsing to the track's 6rem minimum, and its readout needs a FIXED width or the column twitches on every sample.
